text: Which AI automation consultants in Canberra specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

result.keyword: Which AI automation consultants in Canberra specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

items.markdown:
In the Canberra region, `a blend of specialised Microsoft partners and established local IT/consulting firms` focus on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and practical workflow automation for mid-market and enterprise-adjacent organisations.

The primary local providers matching this specific capability set include:

1. **Frontrow Technology** 
	- **Specialisation:** A dedicated Microsoft Partner holding Modern Work and AI specialisations. Their technical leadership includes certified expertise in Agentic AI Business Solutions and Microsoft Copilot Studio deployments.
	- **Mid-Market & Governance Focus:** They specifically focus on Applied AI (including Copilot Studio agents and Azure AI) coupled with strict data governance. For mid-market and regulated entities in Canberra, they build out tenant configurations that handle data security, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labelling (for sensitive or classified information), and secure scoping to prevent AI overexposure.
	- **Learn more:** Review their service delivery model directly on the [Frontrow Technology Canberra Microsoft Partner Page](https://frontrowtech.com.au/microsoft-partner-canberra).[[1]](https://frontrowtech.com.au/microsoft-partner-canberra)
2. **Netier** 
	- **Specialisation:** A well-established Canberra IT and digital transformation consultancy providing targeted AI and automation services.
	- **Mid-Market & Workflow Focus:** Netier delivers practical, operations-focused AI workflow automation (such as automated invoice processing, document handling, and client onboarding workflows) alongside Microsoft 365 Copilot integration. They focus heavily on AI readiness assessments, custom solution mapping, and end-user training tailored to mid-sized organizational goals.
	- **Learn more:** Explore their specific capabilities via the [Netier AI & Automation Services](https://www.netier.com.au/services/ai-automation-solutions/).[[1]](https://www.netier.com.au/services/ai-automation-solutions/)

If you'd like to narrow this down further, let me know:

- Your **industry or sector** (e.g., professional services, non-profit, defence industry)
- Whether you need help with **governance/security compliance** (like data classification or access controls) or purely **operational workflow speed** 

I can help outline a **targeted discovery checklist** or **questions to ask these vendors** during an initial consultation.
